cuts.line: Don't forget who you are, Mack. You're not Mack, you're the lag master.
Yeah, come on, come on baby. One of the worst approach shots I probably could have taken given the circumstances.
I don't know if you've also noticed, but ever since I remember that I'm the literal lag master, I've been playing so much better. Not a double since.

Let's watch, let's see what the lag master can get up to here.
